The user can choose a the billing code when he is in front of the terminal during the the session is 
opening. 
If the user is already connected and want to change his billing code, he can change it by selecting the 
blue folder icon on the panel: 

If the user would like to change the billing code while he send the print job, the only solution is to use the 
detail popup. 
When it is configured, it open each time a print job is send, on this popup you have the possibility to 
change the billing code:
